first_sku.title: RETURN + REFILL Night Cream with Hyaluronic Acid + Niacinamide - ON PAUSE

raw_variant.description:
Our Refill Scheme is on hold! We're working on a new solution for 2026. Watch this space! 

Return, Refill, Reuse

With our refill scheme you need to have empty UpCircle packaging to return to us. Once you’ve placed your order, you’ll be emailed all the information you need to return your empty packaging to us including the Freepost label.

Existing customers only - please ensure you already have your night cream jar to be returned! 

Thoroughly wash and dry your empty night cream jar using warm soapy water 

Pack your empties up ready to be posted- we recommend saving your original packaging. I f you haven't got your original packaging please wrap them carefully. 

After checking out you will receive an email with a free post label

Print and attach this label to the parcel and drop to your local Post Office - if you don't have a printer, you can handwrite the address on instead 

Once we have received your empties back we will sterilise the jars using dry heat and refill your jar with a fresh batch of night cream 

We aim to turn around refills within 24 hours of receiving them

Your refilled jar will be returned to you to enjoy! 

*Please note, if you are ordering new products as well as refills these will be sent when your refills are returned to you.
